summary_en: Copernicium is a chemical element with symbol Cn and atomic number 112. It is an extremely radioactive synthetic element that can only be created in a laboratory. The most stable known isotope, copernicium-285, has a half-life of approximately 29 seconds, but it is possible that this copernicium isotope may have a nuclear isomer with a longer half-life, 8.9 min.
summary_ko: Copernicium은(는) 전이 금속 원소로, 교육·연구·산업에 활용되는 기본 소재다. 상온에서는 이며 안전 지침을 따라 다루는 것이 권장된다.
